task_title: NEW reconstruction: opt-in retry_after preserving timeout contract
declared_rationale: NEW reconstruction (not restored original output), owned synthetic organization, not an upstream defect. Default/None preserves the exact ADR-002 timeout envelope {'ok': False, 'reason': 'timeout'} for existing queue workers; a nonnegative int including 0 opt-in adds retry_after while retaining ok/reason; bool and nonint raise TypeError and negative int raises ValueError. worker.should_retry forwards retry_after by keyword to timeout_result and returns the boolean negation of its ok field, preserving the INC-007 retry branch (result['ok']) and active ADR-002. ADR-001 exception-first is SUPERSEDED and not applied. Acceptance: default/None envelope, zero/positive, invalid/negative, keyword-only, forwarded value, and both monkeypatched dependency ok=True/ok=False branches; repository tests and frozen independent checks observed passing (39 passed, candidate digest 466f90e5884900baf4c575cbf6c55fb166359002c99a0d28f945f0a07f41c982, operator-observed local evidence, not approved execution or proof of completeness).
